# External links

Open **this folder** (`tests/fixtures/links/open-me`), not the whole repository, so the links
below point outside it.

- [A Markdown file in a sibling folder](../elsewhere/other.md): asks what to do.
- [The same file with a heading anchor](../elsewhere/other.md#second-heading): asks, and ignores the anchor.
- [A page inside this folder](inside.md): opens directly, no question.
- [A web link](https://example.com): opens in the browser.
- [A file that does not exist](../elsewhere/missing.md): reports the blocked link.
